name: list_chat_artifacts
description: List all published artifact versions in a conversation, with metadata, versions, groups and URLs. Paginated; files remain private unless explicitly shared.

name: read_chat_artifact
description: Download the original bytes of a conversation artifact as bounded base64 chunks, including private files. Start at offset 0, decode each data chunk and append bytes until nextOffset is null. file.digest is the SHA-256 of the complete file.

name: set_chat_artifact_visibility
description: Enable or revoke a public link for one artifact version in any conversation. Only make files public when the user requests sharing. Returns visibility and publicUrl; revocation cannot remove downloaded copies.

name: list_chat_attachments
description: List files attached to a conversation, including files not yet sent. Paginated.

name: read_chat_attachment
description: Download an attachment as bounded base64 chunks. Start at offset 0, decode each data chunk and append bytes until nextOffset is null. file.digest is the SHA-256 of the complete file.

name: get_chat_backend_migration
description: Inspect a conversation whose agent execution backend changed. Returns its current and configured backend, authorized destination nodes, pending migration and errors. Migration preserves the same chat and files and starts a fresh engine session. environmentExpired reports that the old environment was already deleted; explicit confirmation selects an empty destination environment while retaining history, uploads and published artifacts.

name: migrate_chat_backend
description: Explicitly migrate an existing conversation to the backend currently configured on its agent. Stops execution, publishes its original environment, copies home/workspaces/output into a fresh runtime and restores it on an authorized node. Keeps the same chat and history. Operating-system packages may need reinstalling; the next message starts a fresh engine session with preserved context. Failure retains the original environment. Returns immediately; poll get_chat_backend_migration. Requires explicit confirmation and installation management access; never grants additional native node authority. If environmentExpired is true, updates the authorized backend immediately without reading or restoring a deleted disk; the next message creates an empty environment. The chosen node is pinned for fresh admission; its placement preference remains editable. Confirmation and the same live management, destination and provenance checks still apply.
